def is_one_difference(s1, s2):
    if len(s1) != len(s2):
        return 'no'
    for i in range(len(s1)):
        if s1[i] != s2[i]:
            return 'yes'
    return 'no'

# Read two strings from stdin, separated by single space
input_str1, input_str2 = input().split()

# Extract strings, trim whitespace
s1 = input_str1.strip()
s2 = input_str2.strip()

# Detect if input strings differ exactly by one character
result = is_one_difference(s1, s2)

# Print result to output
print(result)
